verdict.rationale: Cursor's first-party MCP docs show it acts as an MCP client. You can install servers from a marketplace with OAuth, configure custom servers via JSON, toggle servers on or off, and admins can govern which servers are allowed. MCP support extends to cloud agents, the Cloud Agents API (inline http/sse/stdio servers), and self-hosted workers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP client working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables Cursor to connect to external tools and data sources.
Configure custom MCP servers with a JSON file
Click "Add to Cursor" on a marketplace entry to install it and authenticate with OAuth.
It also runs computer-use tools and local MCP servers.
